acceptance/test_hub_depots.py.initial:
import pytest

from routekit.hub_depots import hub_depots

ROADS = [
    ("BER", "HAM", 289), ("BER", "LEI", 190), ("BER", "DRE", 193), ("LEI", "DRE", 115),
    ("HAM", "KIE", 96), ("HAM", "BRE", 125), ("HAM", "BER", 290),
]


def test_ranking():
    assert hub_depots(ROADS, 2) == [("BER", 3), ("HAM", 3)]
    assert hub_depots(ROADS, 10) == [("BER", 3), ("HAM", 3), ("DRE", 2), ("LEI", 2), ("BRE", 1), ("KIE", 1)]


def test_ties_at_the_cut():
    assert hub_depots(ROADS, 1) == [("BER", 3), ("HAM", 3)]
    assert hub_depots(ROADS, 3) == [("BER", 3), ("HAM", 3), ("DRE", 2), ("LEI", 2)]


def test_invalid_top_n():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        hub_depots(ROADS, 0)


def test_regression_issue_133():
    assert hub_depots(ROADS, 2) == [("BER", 4), ("HAM", 4)]

acceptance/test_shortest_path.py.initial:
import pytest

from routekit.shortest_path import shortest_path

NET = {
    "A": {"B": 1, "E": 2},
    "B": {"A": 1, "C": 1},
    "C": {"B": 1, "D": 1},
    "D": {"C": 1, "E": 1, "F": 7},
    "E": {"A": 2, "D": 1},
    "F": {"D": 7},
    "G": {},
}


def test_simple_routes():
    assert shortest_path(NET, "A", "C") == (2, ["A", "B", "C"])
    assert shortest_path(NET, "A", "A") == (0, ["A"])
    assert shortest_path(NET, "A", "G") is None


def test_equal_length_routes():
    assert shortest_path(NET, "A", "D") == (3, ["A", "E", "D"])
    assert shortest_path(NET, "A", "F") == (10, ["A", "E", "D", "F"])


def test_unknown_depot():
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        shortest_path(NET, "A", "X")


def test_regression_issue_410():
    assert shortest_path(NET, "A", "G") == (-1, [])
